dataset: Trade Seasonality by Marketing Year (Exports & Imports)
source: Derived from DGCIS monthly trade data (quantity, Thousand MT)
units: raw = Thousand MT; share & seasonality = fraction of marketing-year total (0-1)

methodology.marketing_year: Each commodity uses its own marketing year; months ordered to that year
methodology.normalized_share: each month's raw quantity / that marketing year's total (Year Sum)
methodology.seasonality: simple average of the per-year normalized shares across the 3 years shown
methodology.column_used: Export Qty for Exports blocks; Import Qty for Imports blocks
methodology.years: last 3 marketing years; latest Oct-Sep & Nov-Oct windows run through May 2026 (partial), shares normalized over available months
